# utils.solver.Solution { #climatecritters.utils.solver.Solution }

```python
utils.solver.Solution(t, y)
```

Minimal container for the output of a fixed-step integrator.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**t**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [([ndarray](`ndarray`), [shape](`shape`)([n_steps](`n_steps`)))]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Time axis.

<code>[**y**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [([ndarray](`ndarray`), [shape](`shape`)([n_steps](`n_steps`), [n_vars](`n_vars`)))]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   State trajectory; row ``i`` is the state at ``t[i]``.
